o_observador.title: The Observer
o_observador.text: Everyone looks at the camera in silence for 30 seconds. Then each person says, in a single word, what they felt.
o_observador.rule: Anyone who smiles or looks away loses their turn to speak.

primeiro_suspeito.title: First Suspect
primeiro_suspeito.text: The host points: who in this room seems to be hiding something? Each player answers in 15 seconds.
primeiro_suspeito.rule: The most-named must confirm or deny — honestly.
primeiro_suspeito.phrase: Suspicion without proof is still suspicion.

confissao_forcada.title: Forced Confession
confissao_forcada.text: A volunteer reveals something uncomfortable, real, and never told to the group. The group listens without interrupting.
confissao_forcada.phrase: Courage is speaking even with fear.

decisao_coletiva.title: Collective Decision
decisao_coletiva.text: The group has 60 seconds to decide: reveal a secret now or move on. Unanimity required.
decisao_coletiva.rule: If there's no consensus, the host decides alone.

pressao_real.title: Real Pressure
pressao_real.text: The host picks a player. The group asks a direct question. The answer must be at least 3 sentences.
pressao_real.rule: No deflecting. No 'I don't know'. No irony.
pressao_real.phrase: Presence is what's left when the defense falls.

voto_da_sala.title: Room Vote
voto_da_sala.text: Everyone votes: who is being most genuine in this session? The most-voted gets to ask anyone a question.
voto_da_sala.phrase: Authenticity is recognized before it is named.

conexao_obrigatoria.title: Mandatory Connection
conexao_obrigatoria.text: The group picks two players. They have 90 seconds to find something that no one else knows about both of them.

ruptura.title: Rupture
ruptura.text: Each player names someone they would trust least to keep a secret. No softening.
ruptura.rule: The most-named answers: 'Why do you think that?'
ruptura.phrase: Trust is slow. Betrayal is instant.

memoria_que_ficou.title: The Memory That Stayed
memoria_que_ficou.text: Each player shares a moment with someone in this room they still remember vividly.
memoria_que_ficou.rule: No one can repeat the same kind of memory.
memoria_que_ficou.phrase: What stays isn't the moment. It's the feeling.

primeira_impressao.title: First Impression
primeira_impressao.text: The host picks a player. The others reveal, in 10 seconds each, the first thing they noticed about them.
primeira_impressao.rule: The chosen one listens to everything before reacting.

obrigado.title: Thank You
obrigado.text: Someone needs to thank another person in this room for something they've never said out loud. With details.

uma_so_palavra.title: A Single Word
uma_so_palavra.text: Each player picks one word that describes how they feel right now. No explanation. No comment.
uma_so_palavra.subrule: When everyone has spoken, watch for the patterns.

quem_eu_admiro.title: Who I Admire
quem_eu_admiro.text: Without naming them, each person describes someone they admire in this room. The group tries to guess who.
quem_eu_admiro.rule: The admired one confirms or denies being the one described.

ponto_em_comum.title: Common Ground
ponto_em_comum.text: The group has 2 minutes to find something everyone has in common — but that's never been said in this room before.
ponto_em_comum.phrase: What unites us outweighs what separates us.

carta_aberta.title: Open Letter
carta_aberta.text: A volunteer crafts a sentence they'd like to say to someone in this room — and then says it out loud, for real.

30_segundos_de_presenca.title: 30 Seconds of Presence
30_segundos_de_presenca.text: Everyone stays in absolute silence for 30 seconds, looking at the camera. Then each person says one thing they noticed.
30_segundos_de_presenca.phrase: Full presence is the greatest gift.

o_que_nos_une.title: What Connects Us
o_que_nos_une.text: The host points to two players. Each says something they believe they have in common with the other — without coordinating.
o_que_nos_une.rule: The other confirms or corrects with honesty.

apoio_visivel.title: Visible Support
apoio_visivel.text: Each player writes in chat the name of someone in the room who needs the most support today. No explanations. Just the names.
apoio_visivel.phrase: Truly seeing someone is already care.

a_musica_da_sala.title: The Room's Song
a_musica_da_sala.text: If this group were a song, which would it be? Each person suggests one and justifies it in a single sentence.

antes_e_depois.title: Before and After
antes_e_depois.text: Each player completes: 'Before walking in here today I was... Now I am...' No filters.
antes_e_depois.phrase: The encounter changes us. Sometimes imperceptibly.

mentira_favorita.title: Favorite Lie
mentira_favorita.text: Each player confesses a small lie they tell often — and why they still tell it.
mentira_favorita.rule: The group can ask one follow-up question only.

o_que_eu_evito.title: What I Avoid
o_que_eu_evito.text: A volunteer reveals something about themselves they avoid bringing up in conversation. It must be real and current.
o_que_eu_evito.rule: The group can ask only one question — no deflecting allowed.

discordancia_silenciosa.title: Silent Disagreement
discordancia_silenciosa.text: Is there something you publicly agree with but privately disagree? Whoever has the courage speaks now.
discordancia_silenciosa.phrase: Silence can be the biggest lie.

opiniao_impopular.title: Unpopular Opinion
opiniao_impopular.text: Each player shares an opinion they know the group probably won't like to hear.
opiniao_impopular.rule: No one can answer immediately. Sit with it first.

inveja_honesta.title: Honest Envy
inveja_honesta.text: The host picks one person. The others reveal something they envy about them — no disguised compliments.
inveja_honesta.rule: The chosen one listens in silence and afterwards says what they felt.

o_que_nao_disse.title: What I Didn't Say
o_que_nao_disse.text: Was there something you thought but didn't say during this session? Now is your last chance.
o_que_nao_disse.phrase: Words unsaid usually weigh the most.

contradicao_pessoal.title: Personal Contradiction
contradicao_pessoal.text: Each player reveals something they do regularly that goes against their own stated values.

julgamento_justo.title: Fair Judgment
julgamento_justo.text: The group votes: who is being most authentic in this session? The most-voted answers: 'Why do you think that?'
julgamento_justo.phrase: Authenticity is noticed before it is spoken.

a_pergunta_que_temo.title: The Question I Fear
a_pergunta_que_temo.text: A volunteer asks the group a question they're afraid someone will ask them. The group decides whether to turn it back.

ponto_fraco_real.title: Real Weak Spot
ponto_fraco_real.text: Each player reveals a genuine weakness — not the cute, acceptable one, but the one rarely admitted.
ponto_fraco_real.rule: Vanity and irony are not valid answers.
ponto_fraco_real.phrase: Strength is bringing vulnerability into the light.

reacao_honesta.title: Honest Reaction
reacao_honesta.text: The host describes a difficult situation. Each player honestly says how they would react — even if they don't like it.

crenca_que_abandonei.title: A Belief I Abandoned
crenca_que_abandonei.text: Each player shares something they believed deeply and no longer believe today.
crenca_que_abandonei.rule: No defense. Just the honesty about the change.

fronteira_testada.title: Boundary Tested
fronteira_testada.text: Each person reveals a personal limit they once let someone cross — and whether they'd do it again.

erro_que_persiste.title: Lingering Mistake
erro_que_persiste.text: Someone in the group admits the latest mistake they made and still think about often.
erro_que_persiste.rule: The group gives no advice. Only listens.

espelho_duplo.title: Double Mirror
espelho_duplo.text: Each player describes how they believe others see them — and then says how they actually see themselves.
espelho_duplo.phrase: The illusion lives between the two versions.

discordancia_direta.title: Direct Disagreement
discordancia_direta.text: The host picks two players. Each must actively disagree with the last thing the other said.
discordancia_direta.rule: 1 minute each. No interruptions. No softening.

quem_manda_aqui.title: Who's in Charge Here
quem_manda_aqui.text: The group debates in 90 seconds who's controlling the dynamic of this session. The most-named person must respond.
quem_manda_aqui.phrase: Power without awareness is the most dangerous kind.

interrogatorio.title: Interrogation
interrogatorio.text: A player chosen by the group answers 3 questions in a row from the others — without changing the subject.
interrogatorio.rule: Answers shorter than 2 sentences don't count.

acusacao_publica.title: Public Accusation
acusacao_publica.text: Each player completes: 'I suspect [name] is...' The named one can defend themselves in 30 seconds.
acusacao_publica.phrase: Every accusation has a grain of truth.

voto_de_eliminacao.title: Elimination Vote
voto_de_eliminacao.text: If someone had to leave the room right now, who would it be? The group votes. The most-voted explains why they think they were chosen.

o_mais_hesitante.title: The Most Hesitant
o_mais_hesitante.text: Everyone names who seems most evasive in this session. The named person reacts without softening.
o_mais_hesitante.phrase: Hesitation is a truth waiting to be said.

linha_vermelha.title: Red Line
linha_vermelha.text: Each player declares what they consider absolutely unacceptable in any relationship. The group debates whether they agree.
linha_vermelha.rule: No one can criticize the other's line. Only question.

contra_argumento.title: Counter-argument
contra_argumento.text: The host picks a statement said in this session. Each player argues against it — even if they agree.
contra_argumento.rule: It's not a debate. It's an exercise in perspective.
contra_argumento.phrase: Defending the opposite reveals what we really think.

alianca_revelada.title: Alliance Revealed
alianca_revelada.text: The group tries to identify who is on the same side in this room. The pairs named confirm or deny.
alianca_revelada.phrase: Every room has its invisible alliances.

incomodo_real.title: Real Annoyance
incomodo_real.text: Each player reveals something another participant does — inside or outside the game — that genuinely bothers them.
incomodo_real.rule: Name the person. Name the behavior. No detours.

batalha_de_perspectivas.title: Battle of Perspectives
batalha_de_perspectivas.text: The host picks a controversial topic. Two players debate opposing sides for 90 seconds — no pause.
batalha_de_perspectivas.rule: The group votes who was more convincing — not who was right.

desconfianca_declarada.title: Declared Distrust
desconfianca_declarada.text: Someone declares without filter why they distrust another person in this room. The named one listens to everything before responding.

dilema_de_lealdade.title: Loyalty Dilemma
dilema_de_lealdade.text: The host creates a dilemma: betray a friend or take a public consequence. Each player chooses and justifies.
dilema_de_lealdade.rule: No answer is judged. But every one is heard.

parceiro_dificil.title: Difficult Partner
parceiro_dificil.text: The group votes: who would be hardest to have as a partner in a serious project? The most-voted reacts — without defending themselves.
parceiro_dificil.phrase: Difficulty isn't weakness. But ignoring it is.

ruptura_imaginada.title: Imagined Break
ruptura_imaginada.text: Each player describes which behavior from another person in this room could end the friendship or relationship forever.
ruptura_imaginada.rule: Name the person. Describe the behavior. Be specific.

o_que_nunca_contei.title: What I Never Told
o_que_nunca_contei.text: A volunteer reveals something they've never told anyone in this room. The group listens in absolute silence.

duas_versoes.title: Two Versions
duas_versoes.text: Each player describes the version of themselves they show the world — and the version they hide most carefully.
duas_versoes.phrase: The mask protects. But it also imprisons.

vergonha_enterrada.title: Buried Shame
vergonha_enterrada.text: Someone reveals something they did and still carry as a weight. No judgment is allowed — only presence.
vergonha_enterrada.rule: The group stays silent for 10 seconds afterward.

medo_real.title: Real Fear
medo_real.text: Each player reveals their greatest fear — not the acceptable one, but the one that truly scares them when alone.
medo_real.phrase: The fear without a name is the one that controls most.

fantasma_do_passado.title: Ghost of the Past
fantasma_do_passado.text: The host picks a player. That person describes a situation from their past that still defines part of who they are.
fantasma_do_passado.rule: The group can ask only one question at the end.

o_que_eu_destrui.title: What I Destroyed
o_que_eu_destrui.text: A volunteer tells about something they destroyed — a relationship, a chance, a version of themselves. No softening.
o_que_eu_destrui.phrase: Admitting is the first act of rebuilding.

desejo_nao_assumido.title: Unowned Desire
desejo_nao_assumido.text: Each player completes: 'There's something I want but would never admit publicly...' No one can judge.
desejo_nao_assumido.rule: Whoever interrupts loses their turn to speak.

performance_identificada.title: Performance Identified
performance_identificada.text: The group debates which behavior of each person seems to be a performance. Those named react with honesty.
performance_identificada.phrase: Every performance is born of a real need.

confissao_anonima.title: Anonymous Confession
confissao_anonima.text: Each player writes a confession in chat without signing. The host reads them aloud. The group tries to guess who wrote each.
confissao_anonima.rule: No confession is commented on after being revealed.

o_que_me_moldou.title: What Shaped Me
o_que_me_moldou.text: Each player reveals the experience that most shaped who they are — even if they've never spoken about it openly.
o_que_me_moldou.phrase: We are made of everything we've survived.

traicao_de_si_mesmo.title: Self-Betrayal
traicao_de_si_mesmo.text: Someone reveals a time they did something against their own principles — and never told anyone until now.
traicao_de_si_mesmo.rule: The group doesn't advise. It only witnesses.

mensagem_nao_enviada.title: Unsent Message
mensagem_nao_enviada.text: Each player thinks of a message they never sent to someone important. They read it out loud — without saying who it's to.
mensagem_nao_enviada.phrase: What we never send still lives inside us.

momento_de_covardia.title: Moment of Cowardice
momento_de_covardia.text: A volunteer tells of a situation where they should have acted and didn't — and what that omission cost.
momento_de_covardia.rule: The group offers no immediate consolation.

ideia_fixa.title: Fixed Idea
ideia_fixa.text: Each player reveals something they think about often but never mention — a recurring idea, a fear, a fantasy.
ideia_fixa.phrase: What we think in silence defines us.

pergunta_sem_censura.title: Uncensored Question
pergunta_sem_censura.text: The host picks a player. The group asks a question that would normally be inappropriate. One. Just one.
pergunta_sem_censura.rule: The chosen one can answer, refuse, or turn it back.

peso_emocional.title: Emotional Weight
peso_emocional.text: A volunteer describes something they still carry emotionally from a past relationship — without identifying the person.
peso_emocional.phrase: We carry people long after letting them go.

decisao_irreversivel.title: Irreversible Decision
decisao_irreversivel.text: Each player reveals a decision they made that changed the course of their life — for better or worse.
decisao_irreversivel.rule: No declared regret. Just the truth of what happened.

fronteira_invisivel.title: Invisible Boundary
fronteira_invisivel.text: Each person reveals a personal limit they've never said out loud, but that has been crossed many times without anyone knowing.
fronteira_invisivel.phrase: What we don't name cannot be respected.

o_momento_exato.title: The Exact Moment
o_momento_exato.text: Each one tells the exact moment they realized the other was different from anyone they had ever met.
o_momento_exato.phrase: There's a before and an after. Everything changes.

o_nao_dito.title: The Unspoken
o_nao_dito.text: Each partner reveals something they think about the relationship that they rarely or never voice. The other only listens.

meu_maior_medo_em_nos.title: My Biggest Fear in Us
meu_maior_medo_em_nos.text: Each one completes: 'What scares me most in this relationship is...' No minimizing. No trying to solve it now.
meu_maior_medo_em_nos.phrase: Shared fear loses half its weight.

me_surpreendeu_quando.title: You Surprised Me When
me_surpreendeu_quando.text: Each partner tells of a moment when the other surprised them — positively or negatively. With real details.

o_que_nao_pedi.title: What I Didn't Ask For
o_que_nao_pedi.text: Each one reveals something they needed from the other at some point but didn't ask for. The other listens in absolute silence.
o_que_nao_pedi.rule: No 'but I didn't know'. Just listen.
o_que_nao_pedi.phrase: Asking is also an act of love.

a_versao_que_voce_nao_viu.title: The Version You Haven't Seen
a_versao_que_voce_nao_viu.text: Each partner describes a version of themselves the other doesn't fully know yet.

quase_tudo_diferente.title: Almost Everything Different
quase_tudo_diferente.text: A volunteer tells of a situation where the relationship almost took another path — and what made the difference.

expectativa_nao_dita.title: Unspoken Expectation
expectativa_nao_dita.text: Each one reveals an expectation about the relationship they've never expressed clearly — but that exists and weighs.
expectativa_nao_dita.phrase: Unspoken expectations are demands in disguise.

aceito_mas_nao_gosto.title: I Accept But Don't Like
aceito_mas_nao_gosto.text: Each partner reveals something in the other's behavior they accept, but would prefer were different.
aceito_mas_nao_gosto.rule: No irony. No laugh. Straight to the point.

por_que_eu_fico.title: Why I Stay
por_que_eu_fico.text: Each one answers: what makes you choose this relationship every day — even on the hardest days?
por_que_eu_fico.phrase: Love is not a feeling. It's a choice repeated.

o_periodo_de_distancia.title: The Distance Period
o_periodo_de_distancia.text: Each partner identifies a period when they felt distant from the other. No blame — only honesty.
o_periodo_de_distancia.rule: The other cannot rebut. Only receive.

uma_palavra_para_nos.title: One Word For Us
uma_palavra_para_nos.text: Each one picks a word to describe the current state of the relationship. No word is discussed for 2 minutes.
uma_palavra_para_nos.phrase: One word sometimes says more than everything.

a_pergunta_que_evito.title: The Question I Avoid
a_pergunta_que_evito.text: Each partner reveals a question they avoid asking the other. The other decides whether to answer now or ask for time.

como_eu_mudei.title: How I've Changed
como_eu_mudei.text: Each one tells how they've changed since being in this relationship — for better and worse. With real examples.
como_eu_mudei.phrase: Every relationship transforms us. The question is: into whom?

o_que_ficou_para_tras.title: What Was Left Behind
o_que_ficou_para_tras.text: Each partner reveals something they wanted at the start of the relationship and gradually let go of.
o_que_ficou_para_tras.rule: The other listens without explaining why it happened.
o_que_ficou_para_tras.phrase: What we let go of reveals what we chose.

se_eu_pudesse_recomecar.title: If I Could Start Over
se_eu_pudesse_recomecar.text: Each one completes: 'If I could go back to the start of this relationship, I would do differently...' With real honesty.

orgulho_real.title: Real Pride
orgulho_real.text: Each partner tells of a moment they felt genuine pride in the other — something they may have never said out loud.
orgulho_real.phrase: Pride unspoken is love that didn't arrive.

o_futuro_que_imagino.title: The Future I Imagine
o_futuro_que_imagino.text: Each one describes this relationship 5 years from now — with honesty about what they hope for and what they fear.
o_futuro_que_imagino.phrase: Speaking of the future together is already building it.
